name: Iris Flare
author: E. T. Carter
description: An off-centre solar-flare iris filling the frame: the radial pattern is anchored on a focal point pushed off-centre so the frame reads composed rather than as a lone centred disc. Wispy streamers erupt from a hot core like solar prominences, longer and brighter across the open side and shorter behind, all flickering on their own phases, with a broad warm glow so the far corners never go dead-black.

params.label: Streamers
params.effect: Number of flare streamers around the focal point; fewer reads as bold prominences, more as a fine solar corona.

params.label: Off-centre
params.effect: How far the focal point sits off-centre; 0 centres it, higher pushes the flare toward the corner for a composed frame.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Rate at which streamers flicker and curl on their own phases; 0 holds them steady, higher makes the flare seethe.

params.label: Core heat
params.effect: Radius of the hot near-white focal core the streamers erupt from; larger floods more of the focal point with light.
